@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: Restore a saved prompt cache into the model's own fresh caches, and prove a round trip for every cache type
+---
+## What
+
+The disk tier of the executor prompt cache (see the dependent tasks) must write a session's caches to a file and read them back, also in a new process after a restart. `loadPromptCacheSnapshot(url:)` (`Libraries/MLXLMCommon/KVCache.swift:2033`) rebuilds each cache from its saved class name through `restoreCacheFromMetaState` (`KVCache.swift:2191`). That path has two gaps:
+
+1. `DeepSeekV4Cache` (`Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/DeepSeekV4Cache.swift:363`) is not registered in `KVCacheSerializationRegistry`. `cacheClassName` (`KVCache.swift:1898`) thus saves it as `"KVCache"`, and the load throws "Corrupt prompt cache" because the state has more than 2 arrays. Its `init` needs a `DeepSeekV4Configuration`, thus a restore factory with only `(state, metaState)` cannot build it.
+2. `MiniMaxM3KVCache` (`Libraries/MLXVLM/Models/MiniMaxM3.swift:1485`) registers itself lazily, from its own `init()` (`MiniMaxM3.swift:1522`). In a new process, a load before the first `MiniMaxM3KVCache()` fails with "Unknown cache class".
+
+The fix: add a restore that writes the saved state INTO caches the model made. The model knows its own cache shape (`model.newCache(parameters:)`), thus no registry and no configuration is necessary.
+
+- In `Libraries/MLXLMCommon/KVCache.swift`, add `public func loadPromptCacheSnapshot(url: URL, into templates: [KVCache]) throws -> PromptCacheSnapshot`. For each layer `i`: require that the saved class name equals `cacheClassName(templates[i])` (throw `KVCacheError` if not, and if the counts differ); then restore the saved `state` and `metaState` into `templates[i]`. `ArraysCache`, `MambaCache` and `CacheList` refuse a direct `metaState` set (`KVCache.swift:1551`, `:1791`), thus call `restoreFromMetaState(state:savedMetaState:)` for `ArraysCache`/`MambaCache`, and restore each child of a `CacheList` into the template's own children.
+- Keep the old `loadPromptCacheSnapshot(url:)` unchanged.
+- A throw must never leave a half-written template in use: the caller discards the templates on a throw. Say this in the doc comment.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A cache of each type below survives `savePromptCache` → `loadPromptCacheSnapshot(url:into:)` with equal `offset`, equal `state` arrays (`allClose`, exact for integer arrays) and equal `metaState`: `KVCacheSimple`, `RotatingKVCache` (before and after it wraps), `QuantizedKVCache`, `ChunkedKVCache`, `MambaCache`, `ArraysCache`, `TurboQuantKVCache`, `VarianceNormalizedKVCache`, `CacheList`, `DeepSeekV4Cache` (with and without an indexer), `MiniMaxM3KVCache`.
+- [ ] After the restore, one more `update(keys:values:)` on the restored cache gives the same output as the same update on the original cache.
+- [ ] `LMOutput.State` saved with the caches comes back equal.
+- [ ] A class mismatch or a layer-count mismatch throws `KVCacheError`, and does not crash.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/MLXLMTests/PromptCacheTemplateRestoreTests.swift` (Swift Testing), one parameterized test over the cache types above, plus the mismatch tests.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` — the new tests pass. Note: on 2026-09-24, 36 XCTest failures and 101 Swift Testing issues (DeepSeekV4*, MiniMaxM3, Qwen35MTPMetal, SSM chunked) already occur on `stable` before this work. Do not add to that list.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #prompt-cache
\ No newline at end of file
